runs.name: Hawaiian Electric Industries, Inc.; NYSE HE, SEC CIK 0000354707; holding company of Hawaiian Electric, Hawaii Electric Light and Maui Electric, regulated utilities serving about 95% of Hawaii's population on five isolated grids, one reportable segment; 90.1% of American Savings Bank sold end 2024 and 30% of the remaining 9.9% stake sold in ASB's IPO 2026-09-16; Pacific Current investments sold 2025 save one; the Maui wildfire tort settlement with three installments of $479M owed 2027 to 2029; the 10-K names no rival company, PG&E, Edison and Avista chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.entry: Price **$8.75** (close 2026-10-22 as printed by `tools/run.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares **172,728,004** at 2026-07-31 (10-Q cover 0000354707-26-000054, `Screens/cover_shares.py`, no-par stock, issued equals outstanding; the subsidiary's 17,854,278 shares wholly owned and not added; no issuance in the 8-Ks after the 10-Q); market cap $1,511M. Sovereign **5.29%**, US Treasury daily par yield curve, 30-year, 2026-10-22. Read from the 10-K for FY2025 (0000354707-26-000008), the 10-Q for Q2 2026, the 2026 proxy and the 8-Ks; `tools/run.py`'s consolidated operating cash for 2023 and 2024 replaced by the filed continuing-operations lines. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7, seven lines stated in the run file. **Q1 IN**: one regulated utility after the bank and Pacific Current sales, revenue decoupled under performance-based regulation, authorized ROE 9.5%; L2023-011 on Hawaii weighed, not a verdict. **Q2 IN**: the legal franchise over isolated grids stood the fire (Acts 191, 258 and 301 of 2025, the wildfire plan and $350M of its costs approved, ratings upgraded in 2025); rooftop solar 1,418 to 1,857 thousand MWh 2021 to 2025, wheeling allowed, co-op or municipal takeover named as a risk; the regulated return carried to Q3. **Q3 weighs against**: operating cash consumed by capital spending, returns at or below allowed (Maui Electric 4.5%, trailing Core ROE 5.7%), new equity earning nothing. **Q4 no STOP, weighs against lightly**: a featured Core figure excluding wildfire items; a $154M non-cash re-discounting gain in Q2 2026 excluded from owner cash; ten balance sheets read, equity $2,345M (2023) to $1,479M (2024), shares 109.5M to 172.7M (57%), book value per share $21.87 (2021) to $10.21; at 2026-06-30 debt $2,266M, finance leases $499M, wildfire claims $1,348M, equity $1,763M. **Q5 integrity IN** on the documents read: securities and derivative suits settled by insurers ($47.8M and $100M) without admission, recorded as integrity facts; no sentence found of management saying what it did wrong; ability weighs against lightly. **Q6 weighs against**: no buyback in the window; dividend suspended August 2023; CEO cash bonus $1.70M plus a retention award in 2024, the year of the $1.42B loss, partly offset by a zero 2023-25 long-term payout and a 2025 award forfeited if the settlement payments are not made; buyback line written back from Q7 (bottom $8.95, nothing to read against). **Q7 OUT, on the floor**, equity-only central under Q7, The regulated utility: owner cash after all spending $4.5M a year 2021 to 2025 (2021 continuing operations estimated, a CONVENTION of the run), with the utility's net long-term debt raised of $622M credited within the 52% debt share (the utility's own at the latest date, the allowed share not stated) **$128.9M a year**; the remaining settlement subtracted at its after-tax present value, $990M at the Treasury rate (deductibility at 25.75% a CONVENTION of the run); specific (b) leaves the no-growth case alone. Value range **$8.95 a share equity-only** (one case; $10.91 on the 2022 to 2025 base, $9.25 maintenance-only beside; all-equity -$7.94); expected return at the price 5.37% against the floor and the bond at 5.29%; owner cash would need about 8.6% a year for ten years; fair price **$2.65 equity-only, central**, all-equity -$13.18, not positive. Q8 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, facts recorded, not weighed: credit below investment grade since August 2023; interest cover about 2.4 times in 2025; $1.44B gross still to finance 2027 to 2029 through "a mix of debt, common equity, equity-linked securities or other potential options"; the Act 258 liability cap not yet set. Competitors (a CONVENTION of the run, the 10-K naming no rival company): ten-year ROE 2016 to 2025 HEI about 2.0%, PG&E about -1.8%, Edison about 7.3% (5.1% without 2025, unread), Avista about 7.3%. Commits 50362895 (template), 9009229d (Step 0, Q1), f07504e1 (Q2), 422e9f69 (Q3 with Q4), 4ea95f39 (Q5 with Q6), 2d2c6f7a (Q7 with the Q6 write-back, close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Contamination declared: a `Test Runs/` listing showing EDN, ENIC, ES, ETR, EVRG, FE and FTS run names of 2026-10-23, FTS commit subjects, the memory index; none opened or used. Citations: the analyst's `check_ids.py` 52 ids, 0 faults; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_fragcheck.py` 68 id marks, no E-id, no missing id, 33 adjacent quoted fragments, **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) the utility debt credit does not say whose debt (the utility's $622M against the consolidated $291M, about $66M a year of owner cash); (2) the fallback debt share takes a post-fire structure (52% against 41% to 42% before); (3) a fixed liability outside the window has no stated place on the equity-only basis; (4) specific (b) leaves a one-case range, so the fair price has one end; (5) no rule for a fifth year lost to discontinued-operations recasting; (6) the template's Q6 buyback write-back assumes a programme. Could not get: 2021 continuing operating cash; the regulator's allowed capital structure; the settlement's tax treatment; the 2022 equity note; any source outside the filings on the fire's cause. Armed at the equity-only fair price.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 (Hawaiian Electric Industries, HE; holding company of the Hawaii electric utilities on five isolated grids, the bank and Pacific Current sold, the Maui wildfire settlement $1.44B still owed 2027 to 2029; Q1 IN; Q2 IN, the franchise stood the fire, rooftop solar and wheeling against; Q3 against, returns at or below allowed; Q4 against lightly, a featured Core figure, book value per share $21.87 to $10.21, shares up 57%; Q5 integrity IN, suits settled by insurers without admission; Q6 against, pay through the loss year; owner cash $128.9M a year equity-only with the utility's debt credit, 5.37% at the price; value range $8.95 equity-only, one case, vs $8.75; fair $2.65 equity-only, -$13.18 all-equity; no citation slip; not held; armed at the equity-only fair price; framework gaps for the operator: whose debt in the utility credit, the fallback debt share after a distress, a fixed liability on the equity-only basis, a one-case range under (b), discontinued-operations recasting, the template's buyback line)
